protocol.status: post-hoc held-out comparison; not a fresh final test
protocol.model: shared frozen encoder with separate Nano/Mini correctness heads
protocol.data_loss: binary cross entropy over both correctness labels, with each head weighted by 1 / expected query cost and normalized per batch
protocol.prior: independent Gaussian priors on head intercept log-odds; precision in mean-loss units is prior_strength/train_size
